subject: dxf/crossks: check by inner fields not global var and make crossks real tikvtest work (#62918)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s DDL distributed add-index backfill + DXF/cross-keyspace plumbing changes relative to its parent. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in DDL/add-index/infoschema/metadata/state-machine behavior for this commit.
